messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy started: rollout model: redwood/gpt-xxl@v2.3.1 -> routing group 'prod-1' (canary=5%)
eng-oncall-mia: got paged — production error surge, elevated 5xxs on /v1/generate and odd tokenization artifacts in logs
eng-oncall-mia: checking canary logs now, can anyone pull canary vs prod model metadata?
incident-bot: Incident declared: INC-2026-1765554321. Severity: P1. Paging oncall. Pager duty: @eng-oncall-mia
sre-jordan: jumping in. saw increased latency + tokenization mismatches reported by support — examples show garbled tokens in the middle of responses, e.g. "Ġ▁�" sequences
ml-ops-lee: I queried model metadata: canary instances are serving weightset sha256:af3b9c... but prod instances show weightset sha256:3d7f1e... (unexpected).
support-ana: multiple customer sessions surfaced: some completions truncated or containing nonsense tokens, customers reported aborted outputs. A handful of higher-traffic tenants hit >10% bad responses in last 3m.
product-ryan: any customer-facing mitigations we can do quickly? Rate-limit? revert?
eng-oncall-mia: immediate plan: 1) toggle feature flag to route production traffic back to last-known-good model alias, 2) pause rollout, 3) if mismatch confirmed, rollback. Can someone confirm flag name?
ml-ops-lee: flag is feature.routing.use_model_alias. Current alias mapping flipped during artifact promotion step and pointed prod->v2.3.1. I see evidence of a packaging bug where artifact tag mapping used the artifact builder tag instead of weightset manifest tag.
sre-jordan: also seeing tokenizer version metadata: prod nodes loaded tokenizer-package:tokenizer-1.8.0, but new weightset expects tokenizer-1.9.2. That's probably causing parsing glitches.
eng-oncall-mia: ok toggle incoming. @deploy-bot can you flip routing flag to alias 'v2.3.0' and pause rollout?
deploy-bot: Received command. Executing: 
```
PATCH /internal/flags/feature.routing.use_model_alias {"value":"v2.3.0","actor":"eng-oncall-mia"}
POST /deployments/prod-1/rollout/pause {"reason":"canary mismatch P1"}
```
deploy-bot: Flag updated -> v2.3.0, rollout paused. Confirming in config service... done.
ml-ops-lee: verifying traffic: edge routing shows ~95% now served by v2.3.0 alias, canaries stuck at 5%. Good.
support-ana: telling affected customers we are investigating and routing them to a stable model; ETA for full rollback?
eng-oncall-mia: next: we should invalidate KV-cache on the prod nodes to avoid stale kv entries interacting with mismatched weights/tokenizer. I'll run the cache-invalidate job.
sre-jordan: note: some prod nodes already loaded new weightset into memory earlier — need to forcibly restart model shards on those hosts to clear loaded kernel state. I'll coordinate an orchestrated restart on affected shard ids: shard-12, shard-17, shard-21.
ml-ops-lee: root cause hypothesis: artifact promotion job accidentally bundled weightset v2.3.1 with tokenizer-1.8.0 due to a manifest parsing bug; promotion tool set the model alias correctly but weightset checksum didn't match the declared manifest, so weights for v2.3.1 with old tokenizer got pushed to a subset of hosts.
eng-oncall-mia: can we get checksum evidence?
ml-ops-lee: logs: 
```
[2026-03-17T12:12:05Z] promote: artifact_tag=release-2026-0317-98
[2026-03-17T12:12:06Z] manifest.expected_sha=af3b9c7d...
[2026-03-17T12:12:06Z] storage.uploaded_sha=3d7f1e5b...
[2026-03-17T12:12:07Z] warning: manifest mismatch, continuing due to --force flag
```
ml-ops-lee: expected=af3b9c7d... actual=3d7f1e5b... — uploaded artifact differs from manifest.
sre-jordan: that --force flag in the promotion pipeline should have been gated. I'll open a pipeline fix ticket after mitigation.
product-ryan: for customer comms: we should offer affected tenants a short RCA and credit. Support team will own outreach.
support-ana: acknowledged. I'll assemble list of impacted tenant ids from last 30 min.
eng-oncall-mia: rolling rollback plan: 1) keep flag pointing to v2.3.0, 2) restart affected shards 12/17/21, 3) sweep prod nodes to ensure tokenizer package >=1.9.2 installed before re-promoting any new weights, 4) re-run a small canary after patch pipeline fix.
sre-jordan: executing restart sequence now in batches to avoid capacity loss. I'll restart shard-12 (graceful), monitor P95 latency.
[~2m later]
sre-jordan: shard-12 restart completed, p95 stable, error-rate trending down.
ml-ops-lee: cache invalidation job completed across prod pool. Tokenization errors in logs decreased ~80% in last 3m.
eng-oncall-mia: nice. After shard restarts finish and monitoring holds for 10m, we'll keep rollout paused and mark incident as mitigated.
incident-bot: INC-2026-1765554321 status -> mitigated (impact reduced). Oncall: @eng-oncall-mia.
product-ryan: please tag any follow-ups: pipeline force-flag, promotion manifest validation, end-to-end artifact integrity test.
sre-jordan: created follow-up tickets: INFRA-2389 (promotion force flag remove), INFRA-2390 (manifest vs upload sha guard), ML-1123 (tokenizer-version gating).
support-ana: customers notified with interim message; follow-up RCA and credits to be communicated by EOD.
eng-oncall-mia: closing timeline: root cause: misdelivered weightset due to promotion pipeline --force allowing mismatch -> mixed tokenizer/weights in prod -> tokenization artifacts + higher error rate; mitigation: feature flag revert + cache invalidation + shard restarts + paused rollout.
eng-oncall-mia: if no further regressions in 30m I'll close the incident and hand off to postmortem owners. :thumbsup:
summary: P1: misdelivered weightset + tokenizer mismatch during rollout; flag revert, cache invalidate, shard restarts, paused rollout, follow-up tickets created
